Units were sold to third-party investors.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund invests alongside other Macquarie-managed vehicles with substantially similar investment objectives and strategies that, together with the Fund, collectively form the &#8220;METI Program.&#8221; From July 1, 2025 through September 1, 2026, the METI Program (inclusive of the Fund) has sold interests for aggregate cash consideration of approximately $683.3 million</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(2)</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> as part of its continuous private offering.</span></p><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.</span></h2><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p>

A description of the Fund&#8217;s valuation process was included under &#8220;</span><a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2062936/000121390026083228/ea0299573-1012ga1_macquarie.htm"><span style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item 9. Market Price of and Dividends on the Registrant&#8217;s Common Equity and Related Unitholder Matters</span></a><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#8221; of the Fund&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10 filed on July 30, 2026. Transactional NAV is based on the month-end values of the Fund&#8217;s investments, the addition of the value of any other assets (such as cash on hand), and the deduction of the Fund&#8217;s liabilities, including certain fees and expenses, in accordance with the Fund&#8217;s valuation policy.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;padding-bottom:1pt;font-size:6pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;border-bottom:0.75pt solid;margin-right:73.333%;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </span></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:10pt;margin-top:3pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:2.667%;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:2.667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(2)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other Macquarie vehicles conduct their offerings in currencies other than the U.S. dollar; as such, this figure is approximate and based on exchange rates as of the last business day of the preceding month.</span></div></div></div>
